title: Data and Applied Scientist
text: Build ontologies and knowledge graphs, RAG pipelines, embeddings and vector databases to ground AI agents. Query with SPARQL or Cypher. Python and SQL required.

title: ML Engineer
text: Train and deploy deep learning models with PyTorch or TensorFlow. Docker and GCP experience. Strong machine learning fundamentals.

title: Data Analyst
text: Build dashboards in Power BI, write SQL queries, analyse data with Python and Pandas, and present reporting to stakeholders.

title: Backend Python Developer
text: Develop REST APIs with Python and FastAPI, design SQL schemas, containerise services with Docker.
